claim_language: Validation-cycle selective-action design, not a benchmark, holdout, scorer, prompt, or production-policy claim.
gate_constraints: baseline_safety_floor_v2 remains unchanged and is reported in every table
locked-test row-level behavior is not inspected or used for tuning
projection variants are deterministic semantic arbitration, not normalization
LLM sidecar promotion is hybrid clinical selection, not an LLM-first result
changed final candidates require exact evidence and valid source ids
report changed-label precision, wrong-to-correct, correct-to-wrong, deterministic-correct regressions, evidence exactness, source-id validity, and fallback counts
hypothesis: A selective gate can expose narrow projection-boundary-state and LLM candidate-generation rescue sidecars while preserving the deterministic safety-floor final policy until fixed-slice regression accounting clears.

stop_rules.combined_gate: Do not consider until individual projection and LLM sidecar gates clear fixed-slice accounting in a separate replay.
stop_rules.llm_sidecar_gate: Keep diagnostic unless scorable fixed-slice rescues are high precision and the row with sidecar label unknown versus gold multiple per 13 month is explained.
stop_rules.projection_gate: Reject promotion if any deterministic-correct row becomes wrong, evidence/source traces are invalid, or corrections depend on oracle/gold-aware node selection; revise if high precision is tied to Gan-specific convention rather than reusable boundary-state arbitration.

variants.name: baseline_safety_floor_v2
variants.prediction_bearing_behavior: Existing deterministic safety-floor replay; deterministic top remains final whenever the adjudicator disagrees.

variants.name: projection_boundary_state_priority_gate_v0
variants.prediction_bearing_behavior: Ablated projection sidecar selects boundary_state_priority only when graph nodes contain unknown or unresolved boundary state and the baseline projection is not already correct on the fixed slice.

variants.name: llm_candidate_sidecar_rescue_gate_v0
variants.prediction_bearing_behavior: Ablated LLM-sidecar final candidate only when llm_candidate_selector_raw is scorable, evidence/source valid, label-normalized, and in the unknown/seizure-free/current-vs-historical rescue family.

variants.name: combined_selective_gate_v0
variants.prediction_bearing_behavior: Projection gate first, then LLM sidecar rescue only for rows not changed by projection.
